name: Shimotsuke (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shimotsuke city emblem in green, orange and red: a green arc above an orange swirl with a red disc, with the characters 下野市 at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Shimotsuke, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 January 2006.
